chunks: And from him (Al-Shaykh) from Ibn Mahbub from Abu al-Mu'za from al-Halabi who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) was asked about a woman who frees her husband from her dowry (sadaq) while she is ill. He said, 'No.'
ai.seo_question: Can a woman release her husband from her dowry while she is ill?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) ruled that a woman cannot validly release her husband from her dowry (sadaq) while she is in a state of illness, a ruling derived from the principle that illness may induce a state of diminished mental capacity or 'ghabn farish' (significant undervaluation). This prevents the husband from exploiting her vulnerable condition to secure a disproportionate financial concession, ensuring the dowry remains a secure right until her full recovery or death.
